phase1-distribution.title: Phase 1: 打通分发
phase1-distribution.description: Security + onboarding + open source release. 让第一批用户能装上、用上 Android Agent。
acceptCriteria: GitHub release v0.1-alpha published with signed APK

basic-security.title: 基础 Security Hardening
basic-security.description: 5 项基础安全修复：(1) API key 迁移到 EncryptedSharedPreferences, (2) Manifest cleartext traffic=false + Tailscale HTTPS 配置, (3) InsecureSslConfig 门控为 BuildConfig.DEBUG, (4) allowBackup=false, (5) 加 .env.example。全部是直接实现，不需要额外 design。
acceptCriteria: AppSettingsStore uses EncryptedSharedPreferences for API keys

agent-security.title: Agent Security — KISS 4+1 Layer
agent-security.description: 实现 safety_kiss_design.md: Layer 1 AppTier (BLOCKED/CAUTIOUS/NORMAL) + app_tiers.json, Layer 2 perception gate (BLOCKED → mask), Layer 3 execution gate (20 行 PolicyEngine 重写), Layer 4 memory gate, Layer 5 system prompt safety rules + app skill safety sections。删除旧的 per-action risk machinery。
acceptCriteria: AppClassifier loads app_tiers.json and classifies packages
BLOCKED app screen is masked before LLM sees it (perception gate)
BLOCKED app actions denied even in AUTO_APPROVE mode
CAUTIOUS app actions trigger AskUser in SMART mode
remember_experience blocked when foreground app is BLOCKED
Old DEFAULT_RISK_LEVELS and per-action risk code deleted

onboarding-wizard.title: Onboarding Wizard
onboarding-wizard.description: 首次启动顺序引导：Accessibility service → Overlay permission → Battery optimization → API key 输入+验证 → Demo task。Phase 0 先做 API key 手动输入，OAuth 是独立 area。
acceptCriteria: First launch shows sequential onboarding flow
Each permission step has clear explanation and action button
API key input validates against LLM endpoint
Demo task runs after setup completes
onboarding-wizard.note: Implemented in 2026-04-02. OpenAI OAuth added in subsequent work.

open-source-release.title: Open Source Release
open-source-release.description: README.md + LICENSE + CONTRIBUTING.md + SECURITY.md + .env.example + GitHub Actions CI (build+lint+test on PR) + release workflow (tag → signed APK → GitHub Release)。
acceptCriteria: README.md exists with install guide and quick start
GitHub Actions CI runs build+lint+test on PR
Release workflow produces signed APK on tag
open-source-release.note: Pending human review — design not yet discussed

phase2-utility.title: Phase 2: 真实实用性
phase2-utility.description: Prompt externalization + app skill discovery + eval regression CI。Agent 能在用户日常用的 30+ app 上工作。
acceptCriteria: 30+ app skills generated via discovery system
Eval runs as CI gate on PRs

prompt-externalization.title: Prompt Externalization
prompt-externalization.description: System prompt 从 StandaloneAgentDef.kt 等硬编码字符串 → assets/persona/<role>/system_prompt.md。新增 PersonaRepository（接口 + asset 实现）。App skill 迭代不再需要重新编译 APK。对应 OpenClaw roadmap P3 Phase 1。是 app skill discovery 的前置条件。
acceptCriteria: AgentDef subclasses use PersonaRepository instead of inline strings
Changing asset file changes agent behavior without APK rebuild
prompt-externalization.note: Pending human review — design not yet discussed

app-skill-discovery.title: App Skill Discovery 系统
app-skill-discovery.description: 建一个系统让 agent 自己探索 app 并提炼 SKILL.md（含 Safety section）。Discovery loop: 给定 target app → agent 启动 → 系统性探索 UI 路径 → 记录 a11y tree 特征、navigation pattern、pitfall → 生成 SKILL.md draft。英文市场 top 30 app 优先。需要 quality gate（跑 test task / 人工 review）。
acceptCriteria: Discovery system can generate SKILL.md for a given target app
At least 20 new app skills generated and reviewed
app-skill-discovery.note: Pending human review — design not yet discussed

eval-regression-ci.title: Eval 转 Regression CI
eval-regression-ci.description: AndroidWorld full set 作为 regression gate。PR 跑 eval，regression 才 fail。停止 autotune optimization loop（R58 是最后一轮主动优化）。保留 eval infra 不变。
acceptCriteria: CI workflow runs eval on PR
Eval regression detected and reported as CI failure
Eval pass/fail threshold configured based on R58 baseline
eval-regression-ci.note: Pending human review — design not yet discussed

phase3-daily-assistant.title: Phase 3: 日常助手
phase3-daily-assistant.description: Scheduled tasks + notification handling + OpenAI OAuth。把 Android Agent 从一次性工具变成每天都用的 assistant。

scheduled-tasks.title: Scheduled Tasks
scheduled-tasks.description: Cron 式定时任务执行。用户设定 schedule + natural language instruction。AlarmManager/WorkManager 触发 → 启动 agent session → 执行 → 记录结果。UI: 任务列表、创建/编辑/删除、执行历史。
acceptCriteria: User can create a scheduled task with cron expression and instruction
Tasks execute on schedule via WorkManager/AlarmManager
Failed tasks show error and can be retried
scheduled-tasks.note: Pending human review — design not yet discussed

notification-handling.title: Notification Handling
notification-handling.description: NotificationListenerService 监听 → 按用户定义的规则触发 agent 响应。规则引擎：app filter + keyword filter + sender filter → trigger action。用户 explicit opt-in 每条规则。
acceptCriteria: User can create filter rules (app, keyword, sender)
Matching notifications trigger agent task execution
Each rule requires explicit user opt-in
notification-handling.note: Pending human review — design not yet discussed

openai-oauth.title: OpenAI OAuth Login
openai-oauth.description: 参考 OpenClaw 实现：OpenAI Codex OAuth flow。用户用 OpenAI 账号登录 → 复用已有 subscription。和手动 API key 并存。降低新用户 onboarding friction。
acceptCriteria: OAuth login flow implemented for OpenAI
User can authenticate via OpenAI account
Falls back to manual API key entry
openai-oauth.note: OAuth login + CodexResponseClient implemented. Settings integration is a separate task.

settings-restructure.title: Settings Page Restructure
settings-restructure.description: Two-level settings navigation with 3-tab LLM & Auth page. Split manual OpenAI key from OAuth token. Shared OAuth suspend helpers. Provider-linked model filtering.

sr-scaffold.title: Settings Scaffold
sr-scaffold.description: Split SettingsSheet.kt into shell + page composables. Add SettingsPage enum (HOME, LLM_AUTH, AGENT_BEHAVIOR, PERMISSIONS_ADVANCED), SettingsNavigationRow, SettingsSubPageHeader, AnimatedContent page switching with directional horizontal slides. Home page has 3 nav rows + version footer.
acceptCriteria: no settings UI file exceeds 400 lines

sr-credential-split.title: OpenAI Credential Split and Migration
sr-credential-split.description: Split manual OpenAI key and OpenAI OAuth token in AppSettingsState. Update buildApiKeys() to select active credential. Add one-time migration for legacy installs where OAuth token was saved as manual key.
acceptCriteria: manual OpenAI key survives OAuth sign-in/sign-out
buildApiKeys() selects correct credential based on authMethod
legacy migration clears OAuth artifact from manual-key slot

sr-shared-oauth.title: Shared OAuth Reuse
sr-shared-oauth.description: Extract reusable OpenAI OAuth flow from OnboardingViewModel into shared suspend helpers under auth/. Wire helpers into both onboarding and settings. Move token refresh under same shared helper layer.
acceptCriteria: settings can sign in, cancel, sign out, and refresh through shared helpers

sr-llm-tabs.title: LLM & Auth Tab Structure
sr-llm-tabs.description: LlmAuthSettingsPage.kt with TabRow (Sign In / API Key / Local). LlmAuthTab enum. Tab content: Sign In → model dropdowns + placeholder auth card, API Key → model dropdown + key field, Local → local model dropdown + status. Tab switching immediately persists backend/authMethod.
acceptCriteria: three tabs render and switch correctly
initial tab reflects current durable state

sr-provider-filter.title: API Key Provider Selector and Model Filtering
sr-provider-filter.description: SingleChoiceSegmentedButtonRow for provider sub-selector in API Key tab. Provider-linked model catalog filtering. Provider-linked single API key field. ModelCatalog helpers: modelsFor(provider, api?), preferredModelFor(provider, api?). Model/executor canonicalization on provider switch.
acceptCriteria: switching provider updates model dropdown to that providers models
shows only the matching API key field

sr-auth-card.title: OpenAI Auth Card (Sign In Tab)
sr-auth-card.description: OpenAiAuthCard.kt composable for all four OAuth UI states (SignedOut/InProgress/SignedIn/Error). Wire onStartOAuth, onCancelOAuth, onSignOut from MainActivity through MainActivityContent. Sign In tab shows OpenAI RESPONSE models only + auth card.
acceptCriteria: auth card shows correct state for all four OAuth states
sign out clears OAuth but preserves manual key
sign in launches browser OAuth flow

sr-behavior-permissions.title: Agent Behavior and Permissions Pages
sr-behavior-permissions.description: Regroup existing controls into AgentBehaviorSettingsPage (max turns, agent mode, perception mode) and PermissionsAdvancedSettingsPage (a11y, overlay, debug toggle). Move PerceptionModeSelector. Wire Home subtitles.
acceptCriteria: Home subtitle summaries update from live state

sr-tests.title: Validation and Tests
sr-tests.description: Tests for OpenAI credential selection (manual vs OAuth). Tests for sign-out preserving manual key. Tests for provider-linked model filtering and canonicalization. Tests for migration.
acceptCriteria: new state model is covered by tests
existing cloud/local validation still behaves correctly

sec-hardening.title: Security & Privacy Hardening
sec-hardening.description: Holistic security review 后的改进计划。修复边界放置与权限组合问题: intent 控制平面、捕获层隐私拦截、secret 存储、日志 PII、密码字段脱敏、shell blocklist、InsecureSsl、AppClassifier 失败模式。

sec-intent-lockdown.title: P0.1 关闭导出 Intent 控制平面
sec-intent-lockdown.description: Production build 忽略外部 caller 的安全敏感 intent extras (API key, base URL, backend, mode, debug/trace flags)。永不持久化 intent 提供的凭据。外部 goal 需用户确认。Debug build 保留现有行为。
acceptCriteria: External ACTION_MAIN launch cannot persist API keys or routing changes
External launch cannot force BASIC mode
External launch cannot auto-start agent without user confirmation

sec-fail-closed-secrets.title: P0.3 Secret 存储关闭式失败
sec-fail-closed-secrets.description: 移除明文 SharedPreferences fallback。加密存储失败时仅保持内存中凭据, 显示降级横幅。loadApiKeyFromFile() 用 BuildConfig.DEBUG 门控。清理相关 deadcode (prefsFailed flag, plaintext prefs init)。加 test。
acceptCriteria: No long-lived secret written to plain SharedPreferences
Encryption failure visible to user via degraded-security banner
Current-session credentials work in memory without persistence
Production build has no path reading api_key.txt from shared storage

sec-remove-auth-pii.title: P0.4 移除 auth PII 日志
sec-remove-auth-pii.description: 删除 OpenAIOAuth.kt 中 id_token claims 日志和 OpenAiSignIn.kt 中 email 日志。如需调试仅记录 token 存在与长度, 受 BuildConfig.DEBUG 门控。LlmLogger 已有 DEBUG 门控, 无需改动。
acceptCriteria: No token claims, emails, or account identifiers in logcat

sec-capture-privacy-gate.title: P0.2 捕获层隐私拦截 (TDD)
sec-capture-privacy-gate.description: 将 blocked-app masking 移入捕获栈, 在任何制品创建之前执行。BLOCKED app 立即返回遮罩 snapshot, 不写入 raw/sanitized tree 或截图, 不发出含捕获内容的 post-action observation。统一 post-action capture 路径。用 /tdd 先写 test 再改代码。
acceptCriteria: Tracing on a blocked app writes no screenshot or tree artifact
open_app and UIActionInvocation cannot return raw blocked-app observations
Blocked-app session produces only masked snapshots and policy warnings

sec-shell-blocklist.title: P1.2 Shell blocklist 精简
sec-shell-blocklist.description: 将 ShellTool BLOCKED_COMMANDS 从 14 个精简为 4 个: am, pm, reboot, su。解除 rm, mv, cp, chmod, chown, sh, bash, eval, exec, settings。不限制元字符, 不添加 path denylist。
acceptCriteria: BLOCKED_COMMANDS contains exactly: am, pm, reboot, su
rm, mv, cp, settings and other previously blocked commands are allowed

sec-insecure-ssl-debug.title: P1.3 InsecureSsl 编译时 Debug-only
sec-insecure-ssl-debug.description: 将 InsecureSslConfig.kt 移至 debug/ source set, release source set 提供 no-op stub。验证 base URL 覆盖在 debug 之外要求 HTTPS。
acceptCriteria: InsecureSslConfig.kt exists only in debug/ source set
Release build cannot compile any insecure TLS helper
Production base URL rejects non-HTTPS URLs

sec-classifier-fail-closed.title: P1.4 AppClassifier 关闭式失败
sec-classifier-fail-closed.description: fromAssets() 在 app_tiers.json 加载失败时抛异常而非返回空分类器。Session 创建中止并向用户展示错误。不添加特殊 escape action 路径。
acceptCriteria: User sees error explaining the issue
No empty-classifier fallback path in production code

sec-password-suppression.title: P1.1 密码字段脱敏 (isPassword)
sec-password-suppression.description: 在 Perceptor 构建 PerceptionElement 时检查 AccessibilityNodeInfo.isPassword(), 为 true 则抑制 text/contentDescription。所有下游路径自动继承。不做 editable 字段抑制、不拆分 serializer。
acceptCriteria: Password fields never appear with raw text in prompt/history/trace

sec-data-retention.title: P2.2 数据留存控制
sec-data-retention.description: 在 Settings → Permissions & Advanced 页面新增 Data & Storage section。提供 session history/checkpoints/memory/trace 留存设置、一键安全擦除、默认关闭 trace 并启用时给出提示。
acceptCriteria: Data & Storage section visible in Permissions & Advanced settings
One-tap wipe for traces and stored sessions works
Trace defaults to off with clear messaging when enabled

sec-regression-tests.title: P2.3 安全回归测试
sec-regression-tests.description: 为所有 security hardening items 编写回归测试。主要为 JVM unit test, 仅 blocked-app trace test 需要 instrumentation test。
acceptCriteria: Test: external intent with sensitive extras ignored in production
Test: blocked app produces no trace screenshots/trees
Test: password fields redacted from prompt/history/trace
Test: encrypted storage failure does not persist secrets in plaintext
Test: shell blocklist contains only am/pm/reboot/su
Test: AppClassifier load failure prevents session start

sec-app-tiers-expansion.title: app_tiers.json 扩展到 100-1000 app
sec-app-tiers-expansion.description: 将 app_tiers.json 从当前 61 个 app (36 blocked + 25 normal) 扩展到覆盖世界常用 100-1000 个 app。需要设计数据获取流程: 拉取 package name + app name + category (Google Play top charts, AppBrain 等) → 用 LLM 批量评估 tier。独立设计任务。
acceptCriteria: Coverage includes top apps from major Play Store categories
Financial/payment/auth apps correctly classified as BLOCKED

agent-core-simplicity.title: Agent Core 简化
agent-core-simplicity.description: 基于 holistic review 的 agent core 简化。

acs-action-signature.title: P0: 修复 action signature 派生逻辑
acs-action-signature.description: 从实际执行成功的操作派生签名，而非预计算。
acceptCriteria: Action signature reflects actually executed tools

acs-split-step-policy.title: P1: 拆分 ExecutorStepPolicy
acs-split-step-policy.description: 拆为 isFinalTurn() + DelegationSummaryFormatter。移除 WarnApproaching 和 narrativeSummaryOnLimit。

acs-unify-role-defs.title: P1: 统一 agent 角色定义
acs-unify-role-defs.description: 统一 AgentDef + AgentDefinition 为 AgentRoleDef。
acceptCriteria: One definition source for all agents

acs-dead-code.title: P2: 死代码与残留状态移除

acs-observation-unify.title: P3: Observation 表示统一
acs-observation-unify.description: 提取规范 observation payload，消除 prompt/history 时序耦合。
acceptCriteria: Prompt and history project from same source

acs-event-consolidation.title: P3: Event emission 整合
acs-event-consolidation.description: 向 AgentEventDispatcher 添加缺失方法，移除 raw eventEmitter 透传。

acs-tool-arg-decode.title: P3: Tool 参数解码整合
acs-tool-arg-decode.description: 共享 action-target decoder 供 ActionDescriptionFormatter 和 ActionSignature 使用。

acs-text-recovery-audit.title: P4: Turn.kt 文本恢复审计
acs-text-recovery-audit.description: 添加遥测追踪 recoverToolCallFromText 触发率。
acceptCriteria: Telemetry logs fire rate of each recovery path

acs-magic-delays.title: P4: 魔法延迟常量命名
acs-magic-delays.description: 为 delay(200) 和 delay(500) 命名并添加注释。

platform-robustness.title: Platform Robustness Hardening
platform-robustness.description: 基于 holistic review 的平台层健壮性强化。8 个阶段：VD 生命周期串行化、回调超时、手势取消安全、窗口选择、旋转处理、边界正确性、资源清理、回归测试。

pr-vd-lifecycle.title: P1: 串行化 VD 生命周期
pr-vd-lifecycle.description: 添加生命周期仲裁者，生命周期转换排他访问，操作调用共享 Running lease。显式状态替代 volatile。clearCachedProxies() 在 shutdown/broken teardown 调用。start() 添加 rollback。
acceptCriteria: No public VD method can observe half-stopped state
start() cancellation/exception does not leave resources with no owner
Lifecycle transitions cannot invalidate resources under in-flight operational calls
Binder death transitions platform to Broken
Restart after stop does not reuse stale proxies
Operational calls fail fast if platform not Running

pr-bounded-callbacks.title: P2: 回调等待超时限制
pr-bounded-callbacks.description: 添加 callback-to-suspend 桥接辅助工具，带超时和 invokeOnCancellation 清理。应用于 takeScreenshot、takeScreenshotOfWindow、PixelCopy.request。coroutines 1.7.3 中延迟 resume 不崩溃但泄漏资源。
acceptCriteria: captureScreen() always completes inside a bounded deadline
PixelCopy failure falls back cleanly without wedging capture

pr-gesture-cleanup.title: P3: 输入注入取消安全
pr-gesture-cleanup.description: VD 长按和滑动取消安全。DOWN 发送后追踪手势所有权。MOVE 失败视为手势失败。finally 发送 ACTION_CANCEL/UP。IME 抑制在串行化生命周期内。
acceptCriteria: Cancelling long-press/swipe does not leave target UI in stuck touch state
IME suppression and restore cannot race across overlapping calls

pr-window-selection.title: P4: 窗口选择和 root 一致性
pr-window-selection.description: 显式最顶层窗口选择规则。VD 窗口按 layer 排序。修复 getRootOnDisplay() 影响操作定位和隐私门控。Accessibility 侧对齐 capture/action/privacy root 策略。
acceptCriteria: Dialogs/popups do not cause screenshot/tree mismatch
Node actions do not target background windows when higher-layer window is active
getCurrentPackageName() returns correct foreground package under multi-window
Capture, action, and privacy-gating root policies are aligned on both platforms

pr-rotation-handling.title: P5: 旋转和 display 尺寸处理
pr-rotation-handling.description: 通过 WindowManager.maximumWindowMetrics.bounds 获取真实 display metrics。检测宽高/密度变化。几何变化时重建 VD 和 ImageReader。VD 是自包含坐标空间，主要影响 viewer UX。Medium 优先级。
acceptCriteria: Rotating device does not break screenshot cropping, touch scaling, or bounds interpretation
VD geometry matches real display geometry after rotation

pr-boundary-correctness.title: P6: 平台边界正确性强化
pr-boundary-correctness.description: A11y 截图路径软失败。captureA11yTreeWithArtifacts() 重抛 CancellationException。Perceptor 移出 Dispatchers.Main。应用启动返回真实结果。无效 display 状态早期拒绝。Surface 替换修复。Shell fallback 移出调用线程。
acceptCriteria: A11y capture errors return best-effort results instead of aborting turn
Failed VD app launch visible to callers
Viewer recreation does not strand display on dead surface

pr-resource-cleanup.title: P7: 资源清理和低风险维护
pr-resource-cleanup.description: 修复 getCurrentPackageName() rootInActiveWindow 泄漏。修复 isKeyboardVisibleOnMainDisplay() window 泄漏。A11y debug 截图保留上限。删除死代码 (gestureDisplayId, performNodeActionAt)。DISPLAY_FLAGS 文档。
acceptCriteria: getCurrentPackageName() no longer leaks root node on every call
isKeyboardVisibleOnMainDisplay() no longer leaks window objects
Repeated platform use does not grow unrecycled object pressure

pr-regression-tests.title: P8: 回归测试
pr-regression-tests.description: 针对性测试：截图超时、VD 手势取消、binder death proxy 失效、多窗口选择、旋转 resize、surface 替换、应用启动失败传播。
acceptCriteria: Binder death and stale proxy invalidation tested
Window selection under multiple windows tested

tool-system-design.title: Tool System Design 改进
tool-system-design.description: 基于 holistic review + 双盲验证的 tool system 改进。6 个阶段: 观测边界安全、ToolName 元数据修正、action runtime 规范化、shell 加固、router 合约收紧、死代码清理。

tsd-observation-boundary.title: Phase 0: 修复 PostActionAnalysis 观测遮蔽缺口
tsd-observation-boundary.description: PostActionAnalysis.kt:45 调用 buildObservation(it, platform) 未传 appClassifier，导致 mobile_action (click/type/scroll/swipe/long_press) 的 post-action observation 在 BLOCKED app 上不遮蔽。将 appClassifier 从 ToolExecutionContext 线程到 capturePostActionAnalysis → buildObservation。同时让 open_app 在执行时 re-check 目标包的 tier。
acceptCriteria: buildObservation call in PostActionAnalysis.kt passes appClassifier
All 5 executor callers thread appClassifier from ToolExecutionContext
open_app re-checks destination tier before launchApp()

tsd-toolname-stopgap.title: Phase 1a: 添加 ask_user/shell 到 ToolName
tsd-toolname-stopgap.description: ask_user 和 shell 不在 ToolName enum 中，解析为 Unknown(isScreenChanging=true)，导致: (1) CAUTIOUS app 上 ask_user 触发不必要的审批, (2) TurnToolPolicy 将两者归为 screen action 导致同 turn 的 complete_task 被丢弃。添加 AskUser 和 Shell 两个 data object，isScreenChanging 返回 false。

tsd-action-runtime.title: Phase 2: Action Runtime 规范化
tsd-action-runtime.description: 三个修复: (1) SwipeExecutor.kt:49-53 将 ActionResult.Cancelled 映射为 Failed → 改为 Cancelled, (2) TypeExecutor 各路径添加显式 Cancelled 处理, (3) ScrollExecutor.resolveScrollArea() 在显式目标 (element_index/text) 解析失败时返回错误而非静默降级为全屏滚动, (4) refinePointActionTarget() 重定向时在 attempt trail 中添加说明。
acceptCriteria: TypeExecutor explicitly handles ActionResult.Cancelled in all performAction paths
ScrollExecutor returns error when explicit target (element_index/text) fails to resolve
refinePointActionTarget retargeting adds note to warnings/trail

tsd-shell-hardening.title: Phase 3: Shell 加固
tsd-shell-hardening.description: 两个修复: (1) Shell 验证扩展 — 拒绝包含元字符 (; | & $( `) 的命令，或添加 env/xargs/find 到 blocklist, (2) 输出截断时追加 '[output truncated at N chars]' 标记，让 LLM 知道数据不完整。
acceptCriteria: Shell commands with metacharacters (;|&) are rejected or additional dangerous commands blocked
Output exceeding MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS includes truncation indicator

tsd-dead-code-cleanup.title: Phase 5: 死代码清理批次
tsd-dead-code-cleanup.description: 6 项确认的死代码清理: (1) 删除 UIActionInvocation.detectScrollBoundary() (lines 53-58, 87-110), (2) 删除 UiChangeDetector.detectScrollBoundary() (lines 31-49), (3) 删除 PolicyEngine.isEscape() 中 MobileActionName.Back/Home fallback 分支 (注意: enum 成员被 ToolUi.kt 使用，仅删分支), (4) 删除 OpenAppTool companion 中未使用的 UI_SETTLE_DELAY_MS 和 SUGGESTION_LIMIT, (5) SystemButtonTool.kt:71 else branch 改为 error('Unreachable'), (6) 删除 DataQueryInvocation.kt (零调用者), (7) 修复 ActionPriorityOrder.kt 中指向不存在路径的 doc 引用。
acceptCriteria: OpenAppTool companion has no UI_SETTLE_DELAY_MS or SUGGESTION_LIMIT
ActionPriorityOrder doc reference updated or removed
